lines.text: Have you ever felt so angry your cheeks burned like fiery red lava?
Leo lost his favorite blue toy car and felt an explosive volcano rumble inside!
He wanted to stomp, scream, and throw his pillow across the bedroom!
Then Rhymo whispered, When the volcano bubbles, freeze and breathe!
Inhale through your nose like smelling sweet roses for four slow seconds!
Blow out gently through your lips like blowing out birthday candles!
One, two, three! The fiery red heat vanished into gentle cool air!
You are the boss of your feelings, not the fiery volcano!
Stay calm, cool, and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily stories!
